Provided are: a sealing material sheet for solar cell modules, and a sealing material-integrated rear-surface protecting sheet. A sealing material sheet 1 for solar cell modules, which has a thickness of from 200 μm to 400 μm (inclusive) and comprises a core layer 11 and a skin layer 12, and wherein: the core layer 11 contains from 5% by mass to 40% by mass (inclusive) of a polypropylene and from 60% by mass to 95% by mass (inclusive) of a low-density polyethylene having a density of from 0.910 g/cm3 to 0.940 g/cm3 (inclusive) in terms of content ratios to all the resin components; and the skin layer 12 contains from 80% by mass to 100% by mass (inclusive) of a low-density polyethylene having a density of 0.880 g/cm3 or more but less than 0.910 g/cm3 in terms of a content ratio to all the resin components, without containing a polypropylene.

outputs.L3:
The invention relates to a sealing material sheet for solar cell modules, as well as a rear-surface protective sheet integrated with the sealing material. The sealing material sheet has a thickness of 200 μm to 400 μm and includes a core layer and a skin layer.

The core layer comprises, relative to the total mass of its resin components, 5% to 40% by mass polypropylene and 60% to 95% by mass low-density polyethylene. The low-density polyethylene in the core layer has a density ranging from 0.910 g/cm³ to 0.940 g/cm³.

The skin layer contains no polypropylene. Instead, it comprises 80% to 100% by mass low-density polyethylene, based on the total mass of its resin components. The low-density polyethylene used in the skin layer has a density of at least 0.880 g/cm³ but less than 0.910 g/cm³.
outputs.L4:
A multilayer sealing sheet for solar cell modules is provided with an integrated rear-surface protective sheet. The sealing sheet has an overall thickness of 200–400 μm and includes at least a core layer and a skin layer arranged to seal and protect the rear side of a solar cell module.

The core layer contains 5–40 mass% polypropylene and 60–95 mass% low-density polyethylene having a density of 0.910–0.940 g/cm³. This composition gives the core layer the structural and sealing characteristics required for use in the multilayer sheet.

The skin layer is substantially free of polypropylene and contains 80–100 mass% low-density polyethylene having a density of at least 0.880 g/cm³ but less than 0.910 g/cm³. The lower-density polyethylene used in the skin layer provides an outer sealing surface while maintaining compatibility with the core layer.

By combining the polypropylene-containing core layer with the polypropylene-free, lower-density polyethylene skin layer within the specified total thickness range, the sheet functions both as a sealing material and as part of an integrated rear-surface protective structure. The resulting multilayer sheet is therefore suitable for encapsulating and protecting the rear surfaces of solar cell modules while simplifying the module’s layered construction.

### Provided

The word **“provided”** often expresses a condition. It means that something can happen only if a particular requirement is met. For example, a company may allow employees to work remotely, provided that they complete their tasks on time. In this sense, the word connects opportunity with responsibility.

“Provided” can also refer to something that has been supplied or made available. Resources provided by schools, businesses, or communities can help people achieve their goals. Whether it introduces a condition or describes support that has been given, the word highlights the relationship between needs, expectations, and outcomes.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract for a solar cell module sealing material sheet having a 200–400 μm core/skin structure, specifying the polypropylene and low-density polyethylene compositions and density ranges of each layer.
counterfactuals.output: A solar cell module sealing material sheet is provided, comprising a core layer and skin layers disposed on both surfaces of the core layer, the sheet having a total thickness of 200–400 μm. The core layer comprises at least 80 mass% of a polypropylene resin having a density of 0.880–0.920 g/cm³, and optionally comprises up to 20 mass% of a low-density polyethylene and/or an elastomer. Each skin layer comprises at least 80 mass% of a low-density polyethylene having a density of 0.880–0.930 g/cm³, and optionally comprises up to 20 mass% of a polypropylene resin and/or an elastomer. The core layer constitutes 50–90% of the total sheet thickness, and the skin layers together constitute 10–50% thereof. The multilayer sheet provides a balance of heat resistance, flexibility, interlayer adhesion, electrical insulation, and moisture-barrier properties suitable for sealing solar cells in a photovoltaic module.
